summary: The thread discusses adding a batch signing endpoint to the REST catalog spec to support the new FILE type where each row may reference an external object. Participants highlight the need to include authorization context per element, potentially altering the request design to accommodate file reference permissions. The community largely agrees, suggesting a refactor-first approach that deprecates Jackson‑typed APIs before adding Jackson 3 support, and recommends splitting the work into several PRs. The discussion highlights a community health dashboard inspired by LF CHAOSS, with plans to extend it as an ASF infrastructure service for projects.
